twitter-command 0.1.0

- Initial release of twitter-cli skill.
- Supports all Twitter/X operations via the command line: reading, posting, replying, quoting, liking, retweeting, following, searching, and user lookups.
- Includes detailed authentication guidance and troubleshooting for user credential setup.
- Provides flexible output options: rich table, YAML, JSON, full text, and compact modes.
- Contains comprehensive command reference and practical agent workflows for common Twitter tasks.
